title: VotingOntoSec: A Security Ontology for Risk Modeling in Electronic Voting Systems
description: Reproducibility package for the paper "VotingOntoSec: A Security Ontology for Risk Modeling in Electronic Voting Systems" (Scientific Journal of Astana IT University). Includes the OWL 2 DL ontology (RDF/XML), Python scripts to rebuild the ontology with owlready2, run the HermiT reasoner, and reproduce the risk heat map and multi-asset use-case figures.
